digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI workflow and documentation gate routing
propositions: Documentation-only patchsets must route to a reduced Verify lane that executes only documentation gates, skipping the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs

The routing decision must execute classifier logic and allowlist only from trusted origin/main with fail-closed semantics: any path type (Python, shell, workflows, dependencies, tests, config, unknown) or diff resolution failure routes to full Verify

Current inline documentation gate commands must be extracted into a single shared composite action at .github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml, invoked by both full and docs-only routes, with inline copies removed and all structural test consumers migrated
Classifier job failure must trigger full-route job execution through always() gating and simultaneously block Verified, ensuring fail-closed security even when full jobs pass
Docs-only route selection reduces wall-clock time by ~82% and runner-minutes by ~94% compared to baseline full runs while retaining all documentation validation gates
